name: Black Swan Strategy
overview:
In her previous life, she abandoned her boyfriend to escape the slums. When they met again, he had become a gangster, and she had become a prostitute. After being shot, she was reborn. He is a bodyguard and she is a young woman. Love and estrangement are intertwined. In her previous life, she was betrayed and fell into the abyss. In this life, she pretends to be a black swan and has a tragic love affair with her fiancé. He protects her with his life in the dark night. She is his obsession and faith.

(Source: Chinese = Douban || Translation = Google Translate)
